root.label: Promotion Price Limits
#/properties/maxDiscountPercent.label: Max Discount Percent
#/properties/maxDiscountPercent.descript: Maximum allowed discount as a percentage of the item's current price (0–100).
Whether exceeding the maximum discount blocks the promotion outright (error) or only warns the author (warn).
#/properties/minMarginPercent.label: Min Margin Percent
#/properties/minMarginPercent.descriptio: Minimum required margin as a percentage above purchase price. For example, 10 means the promotion price must be at least purchase price × 1.10.
#/properties/minMarginPercentSeverity.de: Whether violating the minimum margin blocks the promotion outright (error) or only warns the author (warn).
